title: The Wisconsin Blue Book 1913, vote by counties (general election 1912-11-05)

offices.president: President (presidential electors), 1912 general election only, one column per candidate
offices.governor: Governor, 1912 general election only; a column for a joint governor and lieutenant governor ticket counts as governor

note: The 1913 edition prints no county table for the 1912 U.S. House; the district summaries there are gubernatorial.
